label: Seeds
keyFunctions: Protect and package the embryo
Store reserves for early establishment
Respond to hydration and temperature during germination
Carry seed-lot history through vigor, aging, and storage performance

label: Roots
keyFunctions: Extend through apical and lateral root growth
Absorb water and mineral ions across root tissues
Exchange resources and signals with the rhizosphere
Link oxygen, water status, microbiome context, and xylem supply to the shoot

label: Stem
keyFunctions: Support leaves and flowers
Move water through xylem
Distribute photosynthate through phloem
Add radial support through secondary growth

label: Node
keyFunctions: Join leaves, buds, and branches to repeated phytomers
House axillary meristems and buds
Coordinate branch activation and vascular integration
Reorganize shoot architecture after pruning and directional training

label: Fan Leaves
keyFunctions: Capture light and fix carbon
Exchange carbon dioxide and water vapor through stomata
Move water and assimilates through leaf veins
Change morphology and photosynthetic capacity across development and leaf age

label: Flowers
keyFunctions: Build condensed reproductive architecture from repeated phytomers and branch orders
Enclose the ovary and ovule while exposing stigmatic pollen-reception surfaces
Support pollination, fertilization, and later seed development
Carry dense glandular trichomes whose development changes with genotype, tissue age, and sampling position

label: Trichomes
keyFunctions: Differentiate from epidermal precursor states into specialized glandular structures
Synthesize specialized metabolites in secretory head tissues and store them in a subcuticular cavity
Use distinct stipe and stalk tissues associated with structural support, transport, precursor supply, and signaling
Provide microscopic developmental observations only when tissue, gland integrity, lighting, and sample location are controlled

label: Sex Biology
dataTitle: XX/XY context, ethylene plasticity & pollen fitness
keyFunctions: Express reproductive morphology from chromosome, developmental, and hormone context
Produce, release, receive, and germinate pollen
Enable fertilization and embryo development
Preserve breeding evidence through viability tests, isolation, labeling, and controlled pollination records

label: Environment
dataTitle: PPFD, DLI, CO2, temperature, VPD & coupled limits
keyFunctions: Separate instantaneous PPFD, daily light integral, and photoperiod
Connect CO2 diffusion and stomatal behavior to photosynthetic response
Compare local canopy acclimation and leaf temperature
Show environmental resources as interacting limits rather than isolated target numbers

label: Diagnostics
keyFunctions: Locate and describe symptoms before naming causes
Pair visual progression with environment, root-zone, and tissue measurements
Separate overlapping biotic and abiotic clues
Choose discriminating microscopy, tissue, or pathogen tests before escalating diagnostic certainty
